snippet.title: BreakEven - Idle Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Idle by default, deep when you lean in. BreakEven is an idle ARPG that embraces the grind, making sure it rewards you. Grind your way through a dark fantasy realm, get the best loot, and customize your Knight, Mage, Archer or Necromancer into an ever-expanding damage machine.

Community - https://www.discord.gg/nBFKdTPr6P

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4833310/BreakEven__Idle/

Demo - https://nknives.itch.io/breakeven-idle-demo
